root_cause: T03 depended on environment_v2 barricade/lantern assets whose manifest explicitly marks production_visual_approval=false; oversized gate-post scaling and dirty grey lane treatment amplified the mismatch.
preserves: T02 accepted terrain/snow/water/work-floor outside the T03 lane mask
changes: Make the entire pointed crown solid snow with a short snow collar on the upper picket.
Remove all dark gate-post collars/bands; retain only tiny warm inset windows.
Use the same warm timber for gate posts and fence pickets.
Reduce rear structure to one thin same-family timber rail.
Keep T02 and T03 route/collision geometry unchanged.
iteration_1_findings: Fence read as round log barricades rather than the reference's dense pointed palisade.
Large round snow caps read as marshmallow discs instead of thin pointed frosting.
Hanging blue/orange lantern assemblies were too industrial and visually dominant.
T03 lane tint remained broader/darker than the clean T02 work-floor treatment.
iteration_2_findings: Palisade silhouette was much closer, but snow frosting covered too little of the pointed crown.
Picket gaps remained wider than the reference.
Rear rails were too dark/thick and competed with the vertical fence rhythm.
Gate markers still read as dark square boxes rather than quiet integrated threshold details.
iteration_3_findings: Snow crown intersected the brown picket point and rendered as a white outline around a brown triangle.
Gate-post dark bands visually merged into a black block at gameplay scale.
Two visible rear rails still competed with the reference's vertical palisade rhythm.
